basis: Plan section 11, Pilot A, and section 13 decision Q1: the owner confirms the pilot lot and chooses the verifier.

checks.title: One source for heights
checks.reason: Pilot A lot not chosen yet (owner decision Q1).
checks.pass_when: Every height shown anywhere comes from the same ZR 23-432 lookup: 30 / 45 / 55, or 45 / 65 with affordable housing

checks.title: Allowance vs. building
checks.reason: Pilot A lot not chosen yet (owner decision Q1).
checks.pass_when: Allowance = 24,180 sq ft (affordable) and 20,150 sq ft (standard). If the fitting building is smaller, the shortfall reason is computed from real constraints and is true.

checks.title: Existing building
checks.reason: Pilot A lot not chosen yet (owner decision Q1).
checks.pass_when: The existing zoning floor area is shown. When it exceeds the new allowance, one flag says so: "Existing building is larger than today's zoning allows; demolition would reduce floor area."

checks.title: Drawings match numbers
checks.reason: Pilot A lot not chosen yet (owner decision Q1).
checks.pass_when: Footprint ≤ lot; floors drawn = floors in the table; per-floor areas match; every label inside a picture (width, depth, yards, floor names and areas) is read from the results, never fixed text

checks.title: Consistency sweep
checks.reason: Pilot A lot not chosen yet (owner decision Q1).
checks.pass_when: An automated check over the whole report finds no value that differs between pages (heights, floors, parking, flood, elevators, units)

checks.title: No duplicate options
checks.reason: Pilot A lot not chosen yet (owner decision Q1).
checks.pass_when: Two options producing the same building are merged or explained

checks.title: Current sources
checks.reason: Pilot A lot not chosen yet (owner decision Q1).
checks.pass_when: Data versions shown and current; every ZR citation exists in the current Resolution

checks.title: Same rule everywhere
checks.reason: Pilot A lot not chosen yet (owner decision Q1).
checks.pass_when: Parking or transit status is applied identically across all options

checks.title: Zoning lot
checks.reason: Pilot A lot not chosen yet (owner decision Q1).
checks.pass_when: The report states that the lots are the architect's selection and the zoning lot is not verified; recorded zoning lot documents, if known, are flagged

checks.title: Lot-split ideas
checks.reason: Pilot A lot not chosen yet (owner decision Q1).
checks.pass_when: Each resulting lot is evaluated with its own lot type (corner or interior), and the subdivision requirement is stated

checks.title: No template sentences
checks.reason: Pilot A lot not chosen yet (owner decision Q1).
checks.pass_when: Explanations such as "another floor would exceed the height limit" appear only when computed as true

checks.title: Units in one place
checks.reason: Pilot A lot not chosen yet (owner decision Q1).
checks.pass_when: The unit estimate appears once, with its formula, and matches everywhere it is repeated
